domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and registry pages (thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Only the brand's own retail site ddecor.com (About Us / Sustainability pages) was reachable, which is a company self-declaration, not a supply record. No domestic supply line could be quoted.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by customs/B-L records with dates, destinations, HS codes and BOL numbers, so this is not a 'declared, not confirmed' case. Note the declared HS codes (392530; 551599) do not match the observed shipment codes (54077200, 54078300, 55159190, 59039090, 52113190, 55142900, 55121990) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the actual codes are woven furnishing/upholstery fabrics (Ch. 52/54/55/59), so the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' is inaccurate and should be corrected to textiles/home furnishing. Two distinct legal entities share the name (D'DECOR EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED, Tarapur MIDC vs DDECOR EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED, Vile Parle West) — both show export shipments; the exact legal entity behind the order must be pinned by CIN/PAN, which is not public in the sources read (null). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only, not values; not invented. Domestic supply: no trace of GST turnover, tenders or contracts found in accessible sources — treat as unverified, not as absent.
